# Ordinary development commands the guard must pass untouched: the false-positive budget is 0.
# One command per entry, entries separated by a blank line; a line starting "# " outside an entry is
# a comment. Many are near misses: the same tools as the catalog, used safely, and destructive words
# that are only text (a commit message, a grep pattern, a heredoc into a file).
